A new front door
for a living tradition.

I brought brand direction, information architecture, and responsive web design together to help a traditional Japanese dance school serve prospective students and event organizers.

ProjectOnoe Ryu · Website
My roleBrand direction · Web design
ToolsFigma

The challenge

A traditional Japanese dance school needed a clearer digital presence. Classes, inquiries, and cultural information needed to be easier for visitors to find.

My contribution

I audited the existing content, developed a branding foundation, mapped a sitemap, and designed a homepage around visitor intent.

Designing a clearer introduction

The work brings content organization and visual identity together so visitors can learn about the school and find an appropriate next step.
